import.title: Import Packing List
import.pageSubtitle: Receive many items at once from a supplier (China) packing list.
import.subtitle: Upload an Excel/CSV packing list from your (China) principal/supplier. Each row is matched to a SKU for you to review before it's received into stock.
import.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx/.xls) or CSV (.csv), max 5 MB. PDF is not supported — request an Excel file.
import.mapHint: Columns weren't detected automatically. Pick the matching columns from the file.
import.referenceHint: optional — e.g. PO or shipment number
import.reviewHint: Columns were auto-detected. Check the SKU match and quantity on each row before confirming. Rows without a SKU won't be imported.
import.truncated: Only the first 1,000 rows were processed.
import.nothingSelected: Select at least one row (with a SKU) to import.
import.errParseFailed: Could not read the file. Make sure it's .xlsx, .xls, or .csv.
import.errNoColumns: Columns not recognized. Make sure there's a product name/description column and a quantity column.
import.errUnauthorized: Session expired. Please sign in again.
import.errInvalidInput: Invalid data. Please check the fields.
import.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

xero.subtitle: Upload a Xero quotation (the PDF you send clients, or CSV/Excel). Each line is matched to a SKU and recorded as a B2B goods-out.
xero.fileHint: PDF, CSV, or Excel — max 5 MB
xero.pdfWarning: PDFs are parsed automatically and may be imperfect. Check each row before confirming.
xero.reviewHint: Match each Xero description to an internal SKU. Your choices are remembered for next time. Rows without a SKU won't be recorded.
xero.truncated: Only the first 1,000 rows were processed.
xero.done: {count} items from {ref} recorded as B2B goods-out.
xero.errParseFailed: Could not read the file. Make sure it's PDF, CSV, or Excel.
xero.errPdfFailed: Failed to read the PDF. Try exporting the quote as CSV/Excel from Xero.
xero.errNoColumns: Columns not recognized. Make sure there's a product description/name column.
xero.errNoItems: No product rows were found in the file.
xero.errUnauthorized: Session expired. Please sign in again.
xero.errInvalidInput: Invalid data. Please check the fields.
xero.errInsufficientStock: Not enough stock for one of the items. Enable 'allow negative stock' or reduce the quantity.
xero.errNothingSelected: No rows with a SKU to record.
xero.errAlreadyImported: This order was already imported on {date}.
xero.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
